topic: AI Company Framework: One-Sentence Multi-Agent Company Orchestration

key_points: MetaGPT (69.9k stars) is the canonical 'First AI Software Company' — assigns different roles to GPTs to form a collaborative entity for complex tasks
Treats a software company as a multi-agent system: SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) encoded as prompts let agents act as PM, architect, engineer, QA
Natural language programming product MGX (mgx.dev) launched Feb 2025, #1 Product of the Day on Product Hunt
Key papers: AFlow (ICLR 2025 oral, top 1.8%), SPO, AOT — automating agentic workflow generation
Mastra 1.0 (27.3k stars) — open-source JavaScript/TypeScript agent framework from the Gatsby devs
Modern TS framework for AI-powered applications and agents; positions agents as composable building blocks
Emphasizes developer ergonomics, workflows, and integration with existing JS/TS stacks
agent-swarm (712 stars) — 'Your Company Agentic Operating System' in TypeScript
Frames the whole company as an agentic OS rather than a set of isolated agents
Focus on orchestration of company-wide agent operations
OPC — One Person Company (193 stars): a full team in a single Claude Code skill
Adaptive agent orchestrator with 11 built-in roles, 4 modes, and adversarial quality control
Popularized the 'one-person company' framing for AI agent orchestration
RoboCo (125 stars) — 'Not a loop. Not a harness. Not a workflow. Not a framework. An AI Agents Organization.'
25-agent software company with role-gated lifecycle, self-hosted, AGPL
Emphasizes organizational structure and role-gating over loose agent swarms

stats.fact: MetaGPT is the most-starred multi-agent framework at ~69.9k GitHub stars, positioning itself as the 'First AI Software Company'
Mastra 1.0, the open-source JS/TS agent framework from the Gatsby team, has ~27.3k GitHub stars
MetaGPT's AFlow paper was accepted for oral presentation (top 1.8%) at ICLR 2025, ranking #2 in the LLM-based Agent category
MetaGPT's natural-language-programming product MGX (mgx.dev) became #1 Product of the Day and #1 Product of the Week on Product Hunt in March 2025
The 'one-person company' (OPC) pattern is gaining traction — OPC (iamtouchskyer/opc) ships 11 built-in agent roles with adversarial quality control
RoboCo demonstrates a 25-agent software company with role-gated lifecycle, self-hosted under AGPL

angles: The shift from single-agent assistants to full 'AI company' orchestration — treating an org chart as an agent architecture
One-sentence framing: an AI company framework is a system that assigns distinct roles to multiple agents so they collaborate like a real company to complete complex tasks
SOPs-as-prompts: encoding standard operating procedures turns agents into reliable role-players (PM, architect, engineer, QA)
The one-person company (OPC) movement — a full team in a single skill/CLI, with role-gating and adversarial QC
Open-source vs commercial: MetaGPT/MGX, Mastra, agent-swarm, RoboCo as the leading open frameworks
Practical adoption: when a multi-agent company beats a single agent, and the orchestration pitfalls (role conflicts, cost, quality control)
